value.rationale: A standard accelerated method on a strongly convex population objective with unbiased interpolating gradients and conservative step can be finitely terminating on every almost-sure sample path yet have exponentially exploding expected squared error. The exact sampling probability boundary, nonzero critical second moment, and exponential equivalent provide usable stability diagnostics beyond numerical trajectories and generic possibility-of-divergence results.
